text: . Prime Minister Narendra Modi today interacted with the ‘Friends of India’ in Bishkek on the first day of his two-day visit to Kyrgyzstan. Four delegations working with India in various fields, including Yoga and Manas Academy, were present on the occasion.After this,  Prime Minister Modi paid floral tributes to Mahatma Gandhi at his statue situated at the Mahatma Gandhi Memorial Park in Bishkek.The Prime Minister will also hold bilateral meetings today with leaders of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) member states. These include meetings with the Heads of State of Russia, Iran, Kyrgyzstan and Armenia.Tomorrow, on the second and final day of his visit to Kyrgyzstan, PM Modi will address the 26th Summit of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation.

. Nepal has issued fresh alert for flood in Bhote Koshi River. It has  urged residents living along the river in Rasuwa, Nuwakot and Dhading districts to remain cautious. The National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA) of Nepal has reported an increased flood flow in the river.The warning comes the death toll from flash floods that struck the Nepal-Tibet border on Wednesday rose to 781, with more bodies being recovered. NDRRMA said, 8,186 people have been evacuated so far from the affected districts, including 227 foreigners. Over 2,500 people are still missing following the disaster.External Affairs Ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said 149 Indian nationals have been rescued so far in Nepal following the tragedy. In a social media post, Mr Jaiswal said contact was re-established with around 50 Indian nationals who were earlier uncontactable. The External Affairs Ministry said that 275 Indian nationals are reportedly missing and around 128 people of Indian origin, holding other nationalities also remain missing.India is continuously supporting the relief and rescue operation in the flash flood hit Himalyan Nation. India has provided 68.5 tonnes of relief materials to flood-hit Nepal and sent technical teams, forensic experts and equipment to assist in search and rescue operations. A fourth flight carrying 11 tonnes of relief assistance landed in Nepal today.The World Health Organisation (WHO) has released One hundred fifty thousand US dollars from the Emergency Fund to support urgent health and other needs of the communities impacted by the devastating flash floods in Nepal. The organization said the emergency funds will support immediate response priorities as WHO is committed to support Nepal through the response and recovery efforts.

. National Sports Day is being celebrated across the country today to commemorate the birth anniversary of one of India’s greatest sporting icons, Major Dhyan Chand. Prime Minister Narendra Modi today paid homage to the Indian Hockey Legend Major Dhyan Chand on the occasion of National Sports Day. In a social media post, Mr Modi said that Major Dhyan Chand’s brilliance in Indian hockey continues to inspire generations. Extending his greetings to all sports lovers, the Prime Minister said that their dedication, passion and determination make the nation proud.The day celebrates India’s rich sporting heritage and encourages people to make sports a regular part of their daily lives. National Sports Day 2026 is being observed as a three-day nationwide campaign under the pillars of Tribute, Play and Move. This year, National Sports Day is being celebrated under the call, Ek Ghanta Khel Ke Maidan Mein”. Various sporting activities are being organised across the country to mark the occasion.In Delhi, Union Ministers Dr Mansukh Mandaviya and Arjun Ram Meghwal participated in a cricket match under the campaign. Talking to the media, Dr Mandaviya called upon people to spend at least one hour on the playing field every week to remain fit and healthy. He said a fit youth and a healthy society are essential for building a prosperous nation. Mr Meghwal said he plays badminton every day. He said sports help people remain healthy and fit and also help in keeping stress away.The government has been making sustained investments in India’s sporting ecosystem, with the results increasingly visible on the global stage. India’s performances at major international sporting events reflect the country’s growing strength across Olympic, Paralympic and multi-sport disciplines.In the Union Budget 2026-27, over 4400 crore rupees were allocated to the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, compared to just around 1200 crore rupees in 2013-14. India’s Olympic journey has witnessed a significant transformation in recent years. The country won two medals at Rio 2016, seven at Tokyo 2020 and six medals at Paris 2024. India’s performance at the Paralympic Games has also improved remarkably. The medal tally rose from four at Rio 2016 to 19 at Tokyo 2020.At Paris 2024, India recorded its best-ever Paralympic performance with 29 medals. India has also consistently improved its performance at the Asian Games. The country won 57 medals at the 2014 Asian Games and improved its tally to 69 in 2018 and scripted history by winning a record 107 medals in 2023. Initiatives such as Khelo India, the Target Olympic Podium Scheme, and Khelo India Rising Talent Identification are strengthening the sporting ecosystem and helping athletes prepare for competition at the highest level.

. Union Home Minister Amit Shah has remembered former President and Bharat Ratna Dr Pranab Mukherjee on his death anniversary.In a social media post, Mr Shah noted that the former President was an ace administrator and scholar, who exemplified a firm commitment to the nation and its constitutional values throughout his decades-long journey in public life.Mr Shah added that his enduring legacy remains an inspiration to new leaders.

. In Squash, India’s Abhay Singh won the men’s singles title at the Tuanku Muhriz Trophy 2026 in Seremban, Malaysia, yesterday. The top-seeded Abhay defeated third-seeded Henry Leung of Hong Kong, China, 3-2 in the final of the PSA Challenger Tour 15 event.The victory marked the 27-year-old Indian squash player’s 13th PSA Tour title and his second of the year, following his win at the Indian Open in Mumbai in March. Abhay, at world No.24, is India’s highest-ranked men’s player. It was also Abhay Singh’s third Tuanku Muhriz Trophy title. He previously won the tournament in 2022 and 2024.Abhay, who won gold in the men’s team and bronze in mixed doubles at Hangzhou 2023, is also part of the Indian squash squad for the Asian Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya. He is slated to compete in the men’s singles and team events. Meanwhile, Rathika Suthanthira Seelan and Anika Dubey represented India in the women’s singles competition. Both bowed out in the round of 16. Squash is set to make its Olympic debut at LA 2028.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has arrived in Bishkek on a two-day visit to Kyrgyzstan. He was received at the airport by Kasymaliev Adylbek Aleshovich, chairman of the Cabinet of Ministers. A traditional Kyrgyz dance performance was also organised to welcome him.Mr Modi is visiting Kyrgyzstan at the invitation of President Sadyr Zhaparov for 26th SCO Summit. On the first day of his visit to Kyrgyzstan, PM Modi will hold bilateral meetings with SCO leaders on the sidelines of the summit. He will also participate in several other programmes. Mr Modi will address the SCO Summit tomorrow.Prime Minister Narendra Modi will first interact with the Friends of India in Bishkek today. He will then visit the Mahatma Gandhi Memorial Park and pay floral tributes at the statue of Mahatma Gandhi. The statue was unveiled by Mr Modi during his visit to Kyrgyzstan in the year 2015.The Prime Minister will also hold bilateral meetings with several leaders of SCO member countries today. These include meetings with the Presidents of Armenia, Kyrgyzstan and Iran, as well as a bilateral meeting with the President of Russia.Mr Modi will also attend the opening ceremony of the 6th World Nomad Games today. The event celebrates the rich and vibrant cultural heritage of Central Asia.Prime Minister Narendra Modi will address the 26th Summit of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation tomorrow, the first of September. Vikalp Shukla, Akashvani News, Bishkek.”In his departure statement on Saturday, Mr Modi said he is looking forward to advancing India’s vision for the region, based on “security, connectivity and opportunity”. He also said India will work with SCO members towards a region free from “terrorism, separatism and extremism”. Mr Modi will also attend the opening ceremony of the 6th World Nomad Games.He said the visit will strengthen India’s strategic partnerships in Central Asia, deepen its civilisational connect with the region and advance the shared pursuit of peace, stability and prosperity. The summit theme is “25 Years of the SCO: Together Towards Sustainable Peace, Development and Prosperity. The summit’s priorities include counter-terrorism, regional stability and coordination on cross-border threats. The Bishkek Declaration and other summit texts are expected to be finalised during heads-of-state session tomorrow.

. Ahead of Independence Day, a platform for creative expression has been provided to the youth in Uttar Pradesh. For this, the ‘Rang De Basanti’ campaign was launched. Under this campaign, the graffiti wall programme organised near Lucknow University today. Artists from the city painted public murals on the theme of a mafia-free and changing Uttar Pradesh. Through these paintings, the Uttar Pradesh of before 2017 and the changes that have taken place in Uttar Pradesh thereafter were portrayed.On the wall, artists used their colours and imagination to portray in paintings the changed positive environment in the state in terms of law and order, infrastructure and opportunities for youth. Young painter Manish Saroj’s painting expressed the pain of Uttar Pradesh suffering under mafia rule before 2017, while also presenting a positive picture of the change taking place now.Under the campaign, a comic distribution and dialogue programme will be organised in Muzaffarnagar tomorrow. During this, an original comic based on communal harmony will be distributed. Along with this, dialogues will also be held with youth in schools. On August 14, the song ‘Azadi from Fear’ of the ‘Rang De Basanti’ campaign will be launched. It will also feature a confluence of rap, music and digital art.

. Indraprastha Gas Limited (IGL) has increased the price of Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) by Rs 3.89/kg. The new rate came into effect this morning. Following the revision, CNG in the national capital will now cost Rs 86.98/kg. In Gurugram, the revised price is Rs 92.1/kg, while consumers in Ghaziabad and Noida will have to pay Rs 95.59/kg.In a statement, IGL said that despite the price revision, CNG in Delhi continues to be among the most economical fuel options for consumers. The company attributed the increase to the re-escalation of the West Asia crisis. It said that the re-escalation of tensions disrupted LNG cargo movements through the Strait of Hormuz, resulting in global LNG prices nearly doubling compared with pre-crisis levels. Additionally, the approaching winter season has heightened urgency in Europe to replenish and increase natural gas storage levels.

. Sikkim Shooters performed extraordinarily in 13th North East Zone Shooting Championship 2026. 13th North East Zone Shooting Championship 2026 concluded yesterday at Guwahati, Assam.Laxuman Adhikari from Sikkim won a historic Bronze Medal in the Master Men’s 10m Air Pistol Individual category in this Championship. This was the first-ever medal won by a shooter representing Sikkim at the North East Zonal level.Two shooters from Sikkim Anu Chettri and Tshering Yangden Bhutia have qualified for the 69th National Shooting Championship 2026 after putting up strong performances in 13th North East Zonal Shooting Championship. Chettri secured qualification in the 10m air pistol event, while Bhutia has been selected in 10m air rifle.In total, 11 shooters from Sikkim competed at the Zonal Championship, with the Sikkim Rifle Association contingent comprising eight pistol shooters and three rifle shooters

. India and Uzbekistan today announced to elevate their mutual Strategic Partnership to Comprehensive Strategic Partnership level. The Central Asian country also agreed to establish a framework for long-term supply of uranium to India and discuss the sites of the mining for rare earth minerals.India and Uzbekistan today signed Memorandum of Understanding (MoUs) in various sectors, including Mining, Ayurveda, Tourism, Economic and financial dialogue, Comprehensive and strategic partnership, Higher education and the environment. Both Countries agreed to set a target of 5 billion dollars of bilateral trade by 2030, which is 5 times the current trade.Prime Minister Narendra Modi also received the highest award of Uzbekistan for his great work and efforts towards the cooperation between the two countries. The “Oliy Darajali Do’stlik” Order is Uzbekistan’s Highest Award for Foreign Leaders. “Oliy Darajali Do’stlik” ordeni, the Order of Friendship of the Highest Degree, in English reads as “Friendship of the Highest Degree” or “the Dostlik Order of the highest degree.” The highest-degree order is reserved for heads of state and government and comparable international figures.Our correspondent reports that on the second day of his visit to the Central Asian country, Prime Minister Modi held a bilateral meeting with President Shavkat Mirziyoyev of Uzbekistan and both sides reviewed the entire spectrum of bilateral relations.The talks focused on expanding cooperation in the areas of trade and investment, infrastructure, critical minerals, mining, defence and security, innovation, agriculture, pharmaceuticals, health, information technology, digital public infrastructure, including UPI and education, among others. Prime Minister Narendra Modi said both countries have zero tolerance against terrorism, extremism and separatism.Mr Modi said, the cooperation between the two countries will not be restricted to the capitals but will extend to city and state-level partnership.During his announcement, Prime Minister Modi said, both countries will work for cooperation in the field of sports and promotion of Hindi. A scholarship was also announced for this purpose.The two sides decided to elevate the bilateral ties to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, reflecting the growing depth and expanding scope of cooperation. Both leaders witnessed the exchange of several MoUs and agreements covering a wide range of areas, including mining, culture, education, tourism, ayurveda, among others. A Letter of Intent for the restoration and conservation of the Buddhist sites of Fayaz Tepa and Kara Tepa in Uzbekistan was also agreed upon

. U.S. forces have struck Iran’s Larak Island in latest round of escalation in the conflict. These are the first American strikes on Iran in almost a month.US CENTCOM has stated that U.S. forces took limited and precise action against IRGC forces involved in laying mines in the Strait of Hormuz, which posed an imminent threat to shipping. It said the action was taken to protect civilian mariners, commercial shipping and the free flow of global commerce.Iran’s Revolutionary Guards said the attack killed and wounded several soldiers and citizens. Iranian media have reported a statement from the IRC saying it had attacked the US bases in Jordan in response.The attacks come just days after US CENTCOM and IRGC both made claims of controlling the Strait of Hormuz. CENTCOM had announced that Strait was clear of sea mines and open for shipping traffic. IRGC in response had said that they have a decisive control of the strait.Brent crude futures have climbed 2% following reports of fresh escalation in US-Iran conflict.

. In Duleep trophy cricket tournament, East Zone bundle out defending champion Central Zone for 266 on day one of the  semi-final match at Chennai today.Electing to bowl, East Zone’s pace attack exploited the favourable conditions from the outset to keep Central Zone under pressure throughout the day. Tripura medium-pacer Abhijit Sarkar was the pick of the bowlers with figures of 3 for 38.   For central zone  Rinku Singh scored  60 off 88 balls and Aryan Juyal’s 46 off 113 balls. East Zone set to begin their first innings on day two, where the pitch is expected to assist seam bowlers further.In another semifainal clash, opting to bat first, South Zone bowl out North Zone for a modest 195 on  day one  at Chennai today. Opening batter Qamran Iqbal provided the sole resistance for North Zone by compiling a gritty 76 off 182 balls. In reply, South Zone reached 40 for 2 at stumps, trailing North Zone by 155 runs. For south Zone, pacer Vidhwath Kaverappa picked a disciplined four-wicket haul to bowl out North Zone at a modest score.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi was conferred with Uzbekistan’s supreme state award, the Order of Oliy Darajali Dustlik, by President Shavkat Mirziyoyev today in Tashkent.PM dedicated the accolade to the 1.4 billion people of India and highlighted that it is a symbol of the enduring friendship between the two civilizations. In a social media post, Mr Modi said that he is honoured to receive the award.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi concluded a successful two-day State Visit to Tashkent, Uzbekistan, yesterday following talks with President Shavkat Mirziyoyev to deepen bilateral ties. Both leaders agreed to elevate India-Uzbekistan relations to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership.The outcomes of the visit extend well beyond the signing of 11 agreements. From critical minerals and uranium to trade, defence, digital payments and education; from Hindi and Sanskrit to sports and heritage conservation, the two-day visit has given a broad and comprehensive framework to the India-Uzbekistan relationship.The elevation of ties to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, coupled with the five-billion-dollar trade target, long-term energy cooperation and greater engagement at the state and city levels, is expected to provide fresh momentum to India’s engagement with Uzbekistan and the wider Central Asian region.A major highlight of the visit came when President Shavkat Mirziyoyev conferred Uzbekistan’s highest state honour, the Order of Oliy Darajali Do’stlik, on Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The award recognises his contribution to strengthening India-Uzbekistan relations and cooperation.

. Mizo footballer Lallianzuala Chhangte has been named Indian Footballer of the Year 2026. The 29-year-old, who recently moved from Mumbai FC to Mohun Bagan, received the award from Indian football legend Bhaichung Bhutia last night. Organised by the Football Players Association of India, the award is decided through votes from fellow players. Chhangte had previously won the honour for the 2023-24 season. Chief Minister Lalduhoma congratulated Chhangte, while the Mizoram Football Association hailed the achievement as a proud moment and said it would inspire the next generation of Mizo footballers.

. India’s Industrial output growth, as measured by the Index of Industrial Production (IIP), expanded by 6.7 per cent in July this year on an annual basis. The July data indicates that industrial activity continued to expand at a healthy pace, although the pace of growth moderated from the revised June level.The sharp upward revision in June’s IIP growth to 8.8 per cent from 7.3 per cent also indicates that the industrial momentum entering the July quarter was stronger than initially estimated. According to government data, Manufacturing, which carries the heaviest weight in the index, grew by 7.3 per cent, while electricity and gas supply posted an 8.7 per cent expansion in July. Water supply, sewerage and waste management rose by 7.4 per cent. However, the mining sector proved to be a laggard, posting a negative growth of 0.9 per cent last month.

. Union Minister Dr Jitendra Singh today informed that around 440 space technology startups are registered in India. In a written reply in Lok Sabha, Dr Singh said Indian National Space Promotion and Authorisation Centre, IN-SPACe has granted 113 authorisations to 52 Non-Government Entities, NGEs to carry out various space activities. Out of these, 18 NGEs are start-ups. The Minister said the Government has undertaken several proactive measures following the liberalization of the space sector. This is being done to promote participation of startups in satellite manufacturing, launch services, downstream applications and space-based technologies. IN-SPACe is facilitating the transfer of available ISRO technologies to industry while also identifying and consolidating the technology requirements of industry for future technology development and transfer. Till date, 118 Technology Transfer Agreements have been executed.

. The Indian Navy today commissioned INS Nipun, the second Diving Support Vessel (DSV) of the Nistar-class, at Naval Dockyard, Mumbai.Speaking at the commissioning ceremony, Chief of the Naval Staff, Admiral Krishna Swaminathan, said that amid a period of strategic churn, Nipun is going to be a powerful addition to the Navy’s specialised underwater capabilities required for multi-domain deep-water operations at sea.He added that Nipun will significantly enhance the Western Naval Command’s capabilities for complex underwater operations as a dedicated diving support and submarine rescue vessel.Indigenously designed and constructed by Hindustan Shipyard Limited (HSL), Visakhapatnam, Nipun is a purpose-built platform designed to support a wide spectrum of diving and underwater operations.The ship is equipped with modern diving systems and underwater intervention capabilities, enabling sustained support to divers operating in demanding conditions at sea. The ship incorporates modern systems for navigation, platform management and precise station-keeping, complemented by specialised facilities for diving, underwater intervention and medical support.

. The government has debunked a post circulating on social media which claimed that the NEET PG exam question papers were leaked in Jaipur.The Fact Check Unit of the Press Information Bureau has said that the claim is misleading as there has been no question paper leak in the NEET PG examination. It said, technical disruptions were faced at Sitapura test centres in Jaipur, Rajasthan which caused due to internal power supply issues. It said, the examination for the affected students will be conducted on 5th of next month.

. The Unified Payments Interface (UPI) has completed ten years of transforming digital payments and has emerged as the backbone of India’s digital payments ecosystem. The UPI, which was launched on 25th August 2016, has surged almost 13 thousand fold in transaction volume. The Finance Ministry said that the annual transaction volume expanded from just 1.78 crore transactions in 2016-17 to over 24 thousand 162 crore transactions in 2025-26. The transaction value also rose sharply from seven thousand crore to nearly 314 lakh crore during the same time period. The Ministry said that UPI has also emerged as a global platform for cross-border digital payments and is currently operational in 11 countries. These are United Arab Emirates, France, Bhutan, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Singapore, Mauritius, Qatar, Cambodia, Greece and Maldives.UPI has emerged as one of the most successful pillars of India’s Digital Public Infrastructure, providing an interoperable, real-time payments platform. Today, it is the preferred mode of payment for millions of users, transforming the way India transacts. By bridging the digital divide, advancing financial inclusion, and expanding access to digital financial services, UPI has empowered individuals and communities across the country while driving broad-based economic participation. The unprecedented scale and reliability achieved by UPI have received global recognition. It said, the International Monetary Fund has acknowledged it as the world’s largest real‑time payment system. As of 2025, UPI accounts for nearly 49 per cent of the world’s real-time payment transaction volume.

. The Government has said that there is no shortage of sugar in the country and all necessary measures will be taken for adequate availability of sugar at reasonable prices. The Consumer Affairs Ministry said that ex-mill sugar prices have declined by around 20 per cent in recent days, while retail sugar prices have also started coming down.The Ministry said it has taken a series of proactive measures to ensure adequate availability of sugar and prevent artificial tightening of supplies in the domestic market. The Government has been closely monitoring sugar prices, stocks and movement across the country. It has decided to introduce a fortnightly sugar allocation system from next month, replacing the existing monthly quota system to ensure that sugar reaches the market in a timely manner.

. Vice President CP Radhakrishnan has said that the country today stands as an important place of transformation and renewed confidence, showcasing the results of collective determination and efforts. The Vice President said this after releasing a book titled Sankalp Se Siddhi ka Modi Yug written by Rajya Sabha MP Ghanshyam Tiwari. He said that whether it is advancing technology, building modern infrastructure, and strengthening national unity and promoting women-led development, education is the tool for empowerment. Mr Radhakrishnan also highlighted the contributions of the country’s youth, women, farmers, workers, and every citizen for their involvement in building a stronger and prosperous nation. He also underlined that Prime Minister Narendra Modi is the only leader in the world to provide free Covid-19 vaccines not only to 140 crore Indian people but also to hundred more countries.Speaking about the book, the Vice President said that through the publication, the author seeks to bring together many aspects of country’s larger narratives, reviving pride in cultural heritage and enhancing the country’s voice at the global stage. He added that the book reflects the journey of the nation and encourages everyone and boosts their enthusiasm.

. Global crude oil prices eased today. Brent crude was trading half a per cent down at 89 US dollars and 30 cents per barrel in intra-day trade. West Texas Intermediate crude was trading 0.8 per cent lower at 82 US dollars and 84 cents per barrel when reports last came in.

. In women’s cricket, India will begin their T20 Asia Cup campaign against Thailand today at Dubai International Cricket Stadium. The match will start at 8:30 PM Indian Time. Harmanpreet Kaur will lead India, while Smriti Mandhana will be the vice-captain.India are the most successful team in the competition’s history, winning three of five editions. However, they enter the tournament after the group-stage exits at the T20 World Cup. Thailand opened the tournament with a win over Hong Kong China on Friday. The eight-team Women’s T20 Asia Cup sees India in Group A with Thailand, Hong Kong, and Pakistan.

. Nepal has intensified efforts to free hundreds of people trapped inside tunnels at hydropower projects, including the Trishuli-3A site, following Wednesday’s flash floods. Rescuers, including experts from India and China have been attempting to make contact but have so far received no response from inside the tunnel.Hundreds of the 2,500 people reported missing are believed to be employees of Nepal’s hydropower projects. Wednesday’s disaster has killed at least 794 people and more than 2,500 people are missing in Nepal. In Tibet, the official death toll is 16, with 546 reported to be missing, while rescuers are struggling to find survivors.Bodies have been recovered from all eight affected districts of Nepal as rescuers race against time to search for those missing and rescue those stranded. A suspension bridge in central Nepal was swept away yesterday due to a fresh flood in the Trishuli River.The bridge connected Ghyalchowk of Gandaki Rural Municipality-8 in Gorkha district of Gandaki province with Charaudi along the Prithvi Highway. The flood, which lasted for around three hours, swept away the bridge at around 11.30 AM. With the flood washing away the bridge, residents of Gandaki Rural Municipality 7 and 8 have lost their access to the Prithvi Highway.Before this, the devastating flash floods on August 26 had swept away a bridge at Dhawadighat, a little distance downstream from Kathmandu. Locals had been using the Ghyalchowk-Charaudi Bridge as an alternative to the Dhawadighat Bridge.

. Defending champions Germany will take on Spain in the Men’s FIH Hockey World Cup 2026 final at the Belfius Hockey Arena in Wavre, Belgium, this evening. It is scheduled to start at 8 PM Indian Standard Time. While Germany will aim to defend the crown they won in 2023 and lift their fourth title, Spain will chase their maiden Hockey World Cup trophy.In the Women’s FIH World Cup final yesterday, Argentina defeated the Netherlands 3-1 in a penalty shoot-out after both teams were locked 1-1 in Amstelveen. Argentina snapped co-host the Netherlands’ dream run of a fourth consecutive and 10th overall World Cup title by winning the crown. Argentina, thus, avenged their last World Cup and Tokyo Olympics final defeat to win their third title.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi will share his thoughts with the people of the country and abroad in the Mann Ki Baat programme on Akashvani at 11 AM on Sunday. It will be the 137th episode of the monthly radio programme. The programme will be broadcast across the entire Akashvani and Doordarshan network, the AIR News website, and the Newsonair mobile app. It will also be live-streamed on the YouTube channels of AIR News, DD News, the PMO, and the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting. Akashvani will broadcast the programme in regional languages immediately after the Hindi broadcast.

. Telangana Deputy Chief Minister Bhatti Vikramarka has directed Singareni officials to explore a joint venture with Karnataka’s Hatti Gold Mines for future gold mining projects. He gave these instructions during a visit to the Hatti and UTI gold mines in Raichur district, Karnataka, on the second day of his tour to the region.The Deputy CM, who also holds the Finance and Energy portfolios, said combining the technical expertise of both public sector companies could improve India’s domestic gold production. He noted that Hatti Gold Mines has vast experience in gold exploration, mining, processing and refining, and suggested that Singareni’s technical skills in coal and mineral mining be combined with this experience. Bhatti Vikramarka said gold plays a key role in the country’s economic security, and government companies like Singareni should take the lead in scientifically exploring domestic gold reserves to reduce import dependence.During the visit, he inspected the production unit, mineral processing centre and electro-winning unit at Hatti Gold Mines. Officials told him the project currently produces two to four kilograms of gold daily. He also visited the UTI open-cast and underground gold mines, and asked officials about mining technology, transport and worker safety. Singareni CMD Dr Buddha Prakash Jyothi and other senior officials accompanied him on the tour.

. The death toll from flash floods in central Nepal has risen to 768 today, with more bodies being recovered. More than 2,500 people are still missing following the disaster. Bodies have been recovered from all eight affected districts as rescuers race against time to search for those missing and rescue those stranded on the fifth day since the disaster.The National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA) of Nepal said, rescuers have so far evacuated 8,186 people from the affected districts, including 227 foreigners.The Nepal government has issued fresh alert for flood in Bhote Koshi River and urged residents living along the river to remain cautious. NDRRMA has reported an increased flood flow in the river. Rasuwa District Administration has advised people in areas near the Bhote Koshi River in Rasuwa, Nuwakot and Dhading districts to exercise caution.External Affairs Ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said that 108 Indian nationals have been rescued so far in Nepal following flash flood tragedy. In a social media post, Mr Jaiswal said that the contact was re-established with around 50 Indian nationals who were earlier untraceable.The External Affairs Ministry said that 275 Indian nationals are reportedly missing and around 128 people of Indian origin, holding other nationalities also remain missing. As per local government source, 598 Indian nationals crossed into Nepal from China in the last two days. Meanwhile, 900 Indian nationals who are yet to depart from China are safe, and Indian Embassy in Beijing is in touch with them directly or through the local government. The Ministry added that Government of India has been working in close coordination with the Nepali and Chinese authorities for the early rescue and relief efforts of those affected by the floods.India is continuously supporting the relief and rescue operation in flash flood hit Nepal. The 4th flight carrying 11 tonnes of relief assistance has landed in Kathmandu, and relief material has been handed over to Nepal government.In a social media post, External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar said that the flight carried essential supplies and technical capabilities to support Nepal’s ongoing rescue and relief operations.Earlier, India had sent more than 57 tonnes of emergency relief supplies in three flights. An ice-rock avalanche following a glacial collapse near the Nepal-Tibet border sent a torrent of water, mud and debris downstream. It wiped out towns and villages, damaging crucial infrastructure and washing away hydropower stations through central Nepal on Wednesday.Meanwhile, the death toll from flash floods in Tibet near the Nepal border climbed to 16, with 546 people, including several Indians, still missing. The massive flash floods struck the immigration port at Gyirong-Nepal border on 26th of this month, where hundreds waited on both sides either to enter or exit Tibet.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has said that the Jan Dhan Yojana has delivered unprecedented scale and transformative outcomes, with an unparalleled impact in the last 12 years. In a social media post, Mr Modi said that Jan Dhan Yojana is playing a significant role in advancing financial inclusion and empowering people across the country. Under the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana, more than 59 crore accounts have been opened so far, with total deposits amounting to 3 lakh 17 thousand crore rupees. The scheme was launched by Prime Minister Modi on this day in 2014. As the world’s largest financial inclusion initiative, the scheme continues to redefine access to banking for all Indians. Under the scheme, 78 per cent of the accounts have been opened in rural or semi-urban areas, and approximately 56 per cent of accounts are owned by women.

. Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) have remained net buyers of Indian equities so far in August. According to the latest depository data, FPIs have invested 30, 919 crore rupees in the domestic stock market so far this month.Of the total investment, 18,791 crore rupees came through purchases on stock exchanges, while 12,128 crore rupees were invested through the primary market. The FPIs have extended their buying streak to a second consecutive month, supported by resilient domestic fundamentals, a stable rupee, strong quarterly earnings and a reversal in chip trade.Meanwhile, the debt market has witnessed a mixed trend in Foreign Portfolio Investors flows. So far in August, FPIs have infused 289 crore rupees in the debt securities through Voluntary Retention Route (VRR). The Fully Accessible Route (FAR) has seen inflows of 627 crore rupees during the period under review. In contrast, FPIs have withdrawn 2,318 crore rupees from the General Limit route.

. The Tata Institute of Social Sciences, TISS, conferred degrees on 1,376 students and scholars at its 86th annual convocation held in Mumbai yesterday.The degrees included those awarded to 35 doctoral scholars and graduates from Master’s, Bachelor’s, Integrated and dual-degree programmes.The first undergraduate batch of Analytics and Sustainability Studies also received their degrees. Director of Tata Memorial Hospital, Dr C. S. Pramesh, was the chief guest at the convocation.

. The Publications Division of the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting has received seven awards at the Federation of Indian Publishers (FIP) Awards for Excellence in Book Production, 2026. The Division’s journals, books and reference publications in Hindi, English and Urdu have been recognised in various categories.Director General, Publications Division, Dr. Dhiraj Kakadia said that the books and journals published by the Division play an important role in bringing diverse and valuable content related to national development, literature, culture, art and contemporary issues to readers. He said, the seven awards received by the Publications Division are a testament to the collective hard work, dedication and excellence of its officers and personnel.

The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) has achieved a major milestone in its nationwide mission-mode drive for Mandatory Biometric Updates, completing more than two crore biometric updates for school children across the country. The special drive, initiated in September last year, has now covered over one lakh 56 thousand schools, enabling school children to complete their Aadhaar biometric. Electronics and IT Ministry said that this has helped Mandatory Biometric Updates service to reach children directly at their schools, making the process more accessible and convenient for crores of students.Aadhaar enrolment for children below five years captures demographic information and a photograph, while fingerprints and iris biometrics are not captured at that age as these biometrics are still developing. Mandatory Biometric Updates helps ensure that the child’s Aadhaar continues to have updated biometric information. The Biometric updates are required when a child attains the age of 5 years and again at 15 years. To encourage timely completion and make the service more accessible, UIDAI had waived the charges for  children in the 7 to 15 years age group from 1st October 2025, for a period of one year. The Ministry said that lack of Biometric Updates in Aadhaar may lead to difficulties while carrying out authentication for receiving benefits under various Government schemes, registering in competitive and university examinations.

Union Finance and Corporate Affairs Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said that as global companies reassess their supply chains and capital allocation, India offers not only the scale of a vast market but also the depth of a long-term investment and operating platform. She made these remarks while addressing a high-level Business Roundtable with leading investors and business leaders in Chicago, United States. She highlighted India’s broad-based growth, reform momentum and expanding opportunities for long-term investment.Ms Sitharaman also emphasised that India’s investment appeal lies in the convergence of scale, sustained economic growth, skilled talent, world-class infrastructure, technological advancement and a decade of consistent reforms.A key focus of the meeting was “Manufacture in India – for India and for the world”, with opportunities across manufacturing, AI and digital, financial services, infrastructure, food processing, defence and advanced technologies. Ms Sitharaman noted that India’s Digital Public Infrastructure, including Aadhaar, UPI, DigiLocker, ONDC and India Stack, has created platforms operating at population scale. She added that the country’s next phase of growth lies in building high-value businesses in AI, engineering, analytics, product development, semiconductors and electronics, with Global Capability Centres increasingly evolving into global innovation hubs.Ms Sitharaman underlined that GIFT IFSC is emerging as an international financial centre connecting global capital with Indian opportunities. Referring to the reconfiguration of global supply chains, the Minister said India combines a large domestic market with globally competitive manufacturing capabilities, with the focus now shifting beyond assembly to deeper component manufacturing, engineering and advanced technologies, supported by Production Linked Incentive schemes.Highlighting initiatives such as Atmanirbhar Bharat and iDEX, Ms Sitharaman said India is strengthening domestic capabilities in drones, autonomous systems and other advanced technologies. She also invited global partners to co-develop, co-produce and build for global markets, urging them to view India not merely as a market to serve but as a platform from which to build for the world.The Roundtable was organised by the Consulate General of India in Chicago in association with the US-India Strategic Partnership Forum.

NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has been launched from Florida, embarking on a mission to explore some of the universe’s biggest mysteries.With a 2.4-metre-wide primary mirror, Roman can capture an area of sky more than 100 times larger than Hubble, allowing astronomers to survey the cosmos on an unprecedented scale.The 4.3 billion dollar observatory is designed to revolutionise infrared astronomy. It carries a specialised instrument called a coronagraph, which can block the intense glare of stars, making it easier to observe faint objects such as exoplanets and planet-forming disks.Over the next five years, Roman could help scientists discover previously unseen galaxies and exoplanets while providing new insights into the nature of dark energy and the evolution of the universe.Named after Nancy Grace Roman, NASA’s first chief astronomer and widely regarded as the “mother of the Hubble Space Telescope.”

. President Droupadi Murmu will address the combined convocation of National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT) in New Delhi today. Graduating students from 18 NIFT campuses across the country will be conferred degrees on the occasion.Union Minister for Textiles Giriraj Singh, Secretary Ministry of Textiles Neelam Shami Rao will also grace the occasion, along with other distinguished dignitaries, members of the Board of Governors, senior officials, faculty members, scholars and graduating students.Established in 1986 under the Ministry of Textiles, Government of India, the National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT) is a statutory institute governed by the NIFT Act, 2006. Over the years, the Institute has emerged as a leading institution for fashion education, bringing together traditional arts and crafts, academic knowledge, design innovation, technology, creative thinking and industry engagement.

. On the eve of Raksha Bandhan, President Droupadi Murmu has extended greetings to people. She said that rakhi thread, tied around the wrist with faith, is regarded as a sacred bond of protection, known as Raksha Bandhan.The President  said that in many shlokas and mantras, Rakshe, Ma Chala, Ma Chala can be found which expresses the imploration that may this bond of protection continue forever. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said that India is likely to sustain an economic growth rate of 7 per cent or more in the financial year 2026-27.Addressing the Indian diaspora in Chicago during her US visit, she said India is likely to maintain its growth momentum despite geopolitical uncertainties and supply-chain disruptions following the US-Iran conflict and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz. She said that the disruption in the Strait of Hormuz due to West Asia conflict initially affected supplies of key commodities such as crude, petroleum products and fertilisers to India, but the country managed to reroute supplies.The Finance Minister highlighted that the government has also kept fertiliser prices unchanged for farmers through subsidies despite a sharp rise in international prices. Ms. Sitharaman further stated that the government will continue with systemic reforms and seek to mobilise more capital, particularly from overseas, as India’s economy expands.

The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas has clarified that the revised pricing framework for Compressed Biogas (CBG) under the GOBARdhan Scheme has been designed to provide a stable and viable price to CBG producers while ensuring that consumers do not face any material increase in CNG and household PNG prices.According to a recent newspaper article, the revised price of Compressed Biogas (CBG) under the GOBARdhan Scheme could place a significant additional burden on CNG and household PNG consumers. However, the Ministry explained that this conclusion does not present the correct picture, as it does not account for the Government’s affordability support and the substantially wider domestic gas pool over which the net cost of CBG will now be distributed.The Ministry explained that under the existing system, the procurement price paid to CBG producers is approximately 1 thousand 478 rupees per Million British thermal units, while the revised procurement price under the GOBARdhan Scheme is 2,110 rupees per Million British thermal units. It noted that the Government will also provide affordability support of 10 rupees per kilogram of CBG, equivalent to around 215 rupees per Million British thermal units with 95 per cent methane content, reducing the effective cost to approximately 1,895 rupees per Million British thermal units.Additionally, CBG will be pooled with other domestically produced natural gas, with its net cost spread across a significantly larger domestic gas pool, approximately 2.5 to 3 times the earlier base. The Ministry highlighted that this wider pooling mechanism will substantially minimise the impact on individual CNG and household PNG consumers.The Ministry further emphasized that the revised pricing framework has been carefully designed to balance two key objectives. These include ensuring a stable and viable price for CBG producers to enable sustainable plant operations, while Government-funded affordability support and a substantially wider gas pool protect consumers from any material impact on prices.

All India Institute of Ayurveda (AIIA), New Delhi has introduced a new course titled GARBHINI MITRA to Strengthen Ayurveda-Based Maternal Wellness Support for the 2026-2027 academic session.The Ministry of AYUSH said that the six-month course is designed to develop trained personnel to provide appropriate health education, lifestyle guidance, and community-level support to women during pregnancy and the postnatal period.The ministry noted that Candidates of 18 years or above, who have passed the Senior Secondary examination from any recognized board are eligible to apply before its last date that is 31st August.Once completed, candidates can work as Garbhini Mitra Assistants, Prenatal or Postnatal Care Assistants, Antenatal Wellness Guides and Maternal Health Support Workers, across different Ayush centres, maternity clinics and wellness institutions.The course inculcates traditional ayurvedic concepts of Garbhini Paricharya, Sutika Paricharya and Garbhadhana Vidhi.

. In the FIH Men’s Hockey World Cup 2026, Germany retained the World Cup title with a 1-0 win over Spain in the final at the Belfius Hockey Arena in Wavre, Belgium, this evening. Michel Struthoff scored the only goal of the tightly contested final late in the third quarter, converting Germany’s only opportunity of a match largely controlled by Spain. His goal secured Germany’s fourth men’s World Cup title.Spain, appearing in their first World Cup final since 1998, enjoyed the greater share of possession and created more chances for long stretches but were unable to find a way through the German defence.Earlier today, Argentina defeated the Netherlands 2-1 to claim the men’s bronze medal.

Maharashtra Minister for Electronics, Information Technology and Artificial Intelligence Development and Cultural Affairs Ashish Shelar has been elected President of the Esports Games Federation (ESGF). Shelar was elected at the federation’s general body meeting, attended by representatives from 22 states.After taking charge, Shelar said efforts would be made to give esports a more structured, transparent and professional framework to attract investment and generate employment. He said esports should be developed beyond entertainment and gaming into a field offering skills, training, discipline and career opportunities for young people.According to the federation, India has around 52 crore gamers, with about 11 crore people playing games every day. Tournaments are organised in 28 games, while esports viewership is estimated at 8 to 9 crore.The ESGF aims to establish a structured system for esports, including national teams, selection processes, competitions, training, rules and international representation, similar to traditional sports. The federation expressed confidence that Shelar’s experience with various sports organisations would provide fresh impetus to the development of esports in the country.

The International Cricket Council (ICC) has taken away the hosting rights of the inaugural edition of the Women’s Champions Trophy to be held in 2027 from Sri Lanka due to government interference in the administration of Sri Lanka Cricket. According to a report, Sri Lanka was set to host the first-ever edition of the women’s tournament, featuring six teams, including the hosts. But the decision could impact their participation as well. The report added that the ICC is likely to decide on the venue of the tournament in its next board meeting, with the move to strip Sri Lanka from hosting the competition set to make a financial impact on the board. The change of venue is also likely to see the Sri Lanka Women’s team possibly missing out on participating, as the tournament was set to host top five teams along with the host nation.
